get.description:
Get admin data.

Fetch admin data.

Sse handler.

Long-lived SSE consume (server → client one-way) - the direct-consumer
transport (bus DESIGN §4.3): the client receives every stream message
as an SSE event and ACKs via `POST /v1/ack`.

post.description:
Produce.batch .

produce N events in one call (BUS-3, bus
DESIGN §4.3 / README §7). Each row runs through the SAME single-produce
core (validation, rate limit, inbox persist, XADD, stamp, audit) - the
batch is a transport-level optimization, not a transaction: rows are
independent and a failed row does not roll back its siblings.

AdminDataRows.description:
The `GET /v1/admin/{resource}` rows payload: the per-resource row
documents the RFW DataTable renders (row cells and per-resource
column sets are service-defined; the RFW renderer reads them
dynamically).

publisher_vertical.description:
The verified producer's vertical claim (VDC-2) - recorded at
produce from the M2M token; consumers assert it against the
event_type's first colon segment (`require_publisher`).

ContainerDirection.description: Layout direction for a container's children.

FieldCondition.description: A visibility condition for a form field.

equals.description: The value that must match for this field to be visible.

field.description: The key of the field whose value to check.
The form field key the error refers to.

message.description: The validation message shown under the field.

FormFieldOption.description: One choice of a select-type form field.

FormFieldType.description: Input widget type for a form field.

FormFieldValidation.description: Validation constraints for a form field.

custom_message.description: Message overriding the default validation error.

pattern.description: Regex pattern the value must match.

FormMethod.description: HTTP method used for form submission.

ListAttributesQuery.description:
`GET /v1/admin/attributes` query - list attributes for one subject (or
all subjects in the env when omitted).

LiveHealth.description:
The `GET /v1/health` liveness payload every service returns: the
status string, the serving service's short name, build identity, and
(when the process tracks them) the count of live connections.
`service` and `active_connections` stay absent when a service does
not set them (e.g. the bus mounts the generic handler).

active_connections.description: Live socket count when the traffic counter is mounted.

service.description:
The serving service's short name (absent when the generic handler
does not carry one).

retry_count.description:
How many retries this message has already burned (nack count -
maintained by the consumer across redeliveries). At `MAX_RETRIES`
the reaper routes the message to the DLQ instead of the retry set.
The retry count.

PolicySetDetail.description: One policy set in the detail view (adds the full policy text).

enabled.description: Whether the set participates in evaluation.

policies.description: The full policy text (Shield policy language).

schema.description: Optional schema text bound to the set.

mode.description: The evaluation mode after the mutation.

PolicySetRow.description: One policy set in the list view (the RFW row shape).

enabled.description: Whether the set participates in evaluation.

id.description: The set name; doubles as the RFW row id.

policies_len.description: Number of policy statements in the set.

PolicyTestOutcome.description: A dry-run (test) outcome; nothing was stored.

policy_set_name.description: The set name the candidate text was compiled under.

would_deny.description: Whether the shadow evaluation would deny.

PrincipalAttr.description: One principal attribute in the list view.

attr_value.description: The attribute value (free-form JSON by contract).

ProduceBatchItem.description: One row's produce result in a `POST /v1/produce/batch` response.

ProduceBatchRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /v1/produce/batch` - N events in ONE call
(bus DESIGN §4.3 / README §7). Rows are independent: the batch is a
transport-level optimization, not a transaction.

events.description:
The batched events (max 100 per call - matches the outbox relay
drain batch).

results.description:
Per-row results, in request order. A failed row carries `error`
and no `message_id` - the batch is best-effort per row.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id; generated by the server when absent.

env_id.description:
Tenant env - must match the JWT-derived tenant context (a
defense-in-depth server check). Absent → the server uses the JWT
claims.

publisher_id_token.description:
Publisher identity token - optional. If absent, the server derives
it from the Authorization header.

publisher_subject.description:
Publisher subject (`sub` claim). If absent, the server derives it
from the verified token claims.

stream_family.description: The stream family to publish into.

message_id.description: Stream entry id (format: `<timestamp>-<sequence>`) or a UUID.

stream.description: The target stream key the event was published into.

RelationRecordRow.description: One relation tuple in the list view.
